saveField.shape: automation: {itemId: 1..99} unmounted cores and unplaced royal cages; mounts: {cageInstanceId: [AUTO_CLEAN, AUTO_FEED]}; editions: {cageInstanceId: ROYAL_RANCH | STELLAR_ZOO}; bondCarry: {partnerId: 0..9 tenths}; the playtest diamond wallet may hold up to 9,999,999

rules.gacha: premium machine: automation takes the top 15% of each SR/SSR/UR category roll (cores 2.1% each, royal ranch 1.5%, stellar zoo 0.3%); R tiers, the ten-pull guarantee and the Bits machine are unchanged

rules.founderBox: fixed: 1,000 diamonds, one feed core, one clean core, five tickets, the founder gold brag frame; free once in the playtest after the first tournament medal
